Class ObjCRuntime

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.connection.ble.macos.ObjCRuntime
public final class ObjCRuntime extends Object
Utilities for working with the Objective-C runtime through JNA.

Extends the pattern used by NativeMacOsWindowControl: besides sending messages with objc_msgSend, it supports class creation and callback-method registration for delegates. CoreBluetooth relies on this delegate pattern.

On arm64 Apple Silicon, variadic objc_msgSend must not be called through JNA; every call goes through Function.invoke*() with fixed argument types.
